title: Harbor flood gates
body: The harbor flood gates are closed when a storm surge is forecast to exceed two meters. Operators reopen the gates after the water level falls and the shipping channel is inspected.

title: Orchard irrigation
body: The orchard uses drip irrigation. A soil moisture sensor starts watering when the soil becomes dry, and a timer prevents watering during the hottest part of the afternoon.

title: Library lending
body: Library members may borrow books for three weeks. A book can be renewed twice unless another member has reserved it.
